name: Teen Line Volunteer Listener (peer hotline)
org: Teen Line, a program of Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services
what_you_do: Teens train to give peer support to other teens by hotline, text and email. Adult mental health pros guide the work.
who_can_apply: Must be at least 14 and live in or near Los Angeles. You can start from fall of 9th grade through fall of 11th grade. Seniors and second-semester juniors are not accepted. Training and shifts are in person in West LA.
duration: Training of 65+ hours (the main Teen Line page says over 100), then at least two evening shifts a month
deadline_text: The page says applications are due "Monday September 8, 2026 by 5pm" (that date is a Tuesday, so confirm the day), which has now passed. Training runs three times a year (Fall, Spring, Summer). Next dates are not posted; the page has an email interest list for future applications.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Then go to every training, interview and orientation session. After you are accepted, show a negative TB blood test from the last 12 months. To hear about the next round, join the Prospective Teen Line Volunteer interest list on the page.
notes: Serious role that handles hard topics. Hotline runs every evening from West LA, no remote option. Training is 65+ hours per the volunteer page (the main Teen Line page says over 100). The page lists no pay and the role earns community service hours.
